items.name: Lo Chudail Chali Sasural
items.overview: Lo Chudail Chali Sasural is a supernatural family sitcom and the Indian adaptation of Bewitched. Urvashi, a chudail longing for a human family, marries Aarav Patel and joins his lively Gujarati joint family. As her magic causes hilarious mishaps, Aarav struggles to protect her secret while her human-hating mother Kamini fuels the chaos. Amid magical mayhem, and family drama, love finds a way.

The six-part documentary series will premiere exclusively on Prime Video later this year.

items.overview: Mr & Mrs Office explores the comedic and chaotic worlds of work-life balance, relationships, and corporate dynamics. The plot centers around a couple navigating the daily grind, combining relatable office tropes with domestic humor and romance.

items.name: Win the Mall
items.overview: Ten teams move into a mall where they must conquer storefronts, forge alliances and outsmart rivals to win $1 million in this reality competition series.

items.name: Pieces of Guilt
items.overview: Detective Qin Yuejian uses her extraordinary photographic memory to solve difficult cases, despite the burden of constantly reliving every detail. When newly transferred officer Liang Wan becomes her partner, the two work together to investigate bizarre crimes while confronting secrets from their pasts.

items.name: El doble
items.overview: "El doble" is a hybrid format that combines the documentary genre with musical entertainment across three episodes. Hosted by producer Jordi Cubino, the show aims to find, select, and train a contemporary performer capable of reviving the Eurodance music phenomenon of the 1980s. Through a casting and preparation process, the program recreates the success and cultural impact that Cubino himself experienced during that decade under the stage name David Lyme.

items.name: The Law of Beasts
items.overview: When the case of a child serial killer resurfaces after 25 years as an unresolved legal and social problem, two former friends are forced to confront the choices that broke their friendship and shaped their lives.

items.name: Small Town Trouble: Texas
items.overview: Set in Boerne, Texas, the series follows a charming yet unconventional group of mothers and social insiders and their husbands as conservative small-town values collide with forbidden attraction, messy friendships, and shocking secrets. Here, perception is everything, temptation is everywhere, and the truth is never as buttoned-up as it looks.

items.name: Her Willing Subject
items.overview: Reborn after a tragic end in their previous lives, Lu Qingcang and Shen Shuying resume their rivalry as regent and empress, but find themselves drawn together as they gradually uncover the truth.

items.name: Valentina and the 12 Signs

results.overview: Manouchehr and Nosrat, the family's good-for-nothing, unemployed sons, turn to gangster antics to win over the father of Haydeh and Homayra. But this is no ordinary game!

results.name: Inventeur Gadget - Les 1000 vies de Jean Chalopin
results.original_name: Inventeur Gadget - Les 1000 vies de Jean Chalopin

results.name: Sweet Homes
results.overview: What starts as an idea between friends quickly becomes their biggest gamble yet. Together, they set out to build a million-dollar dream home on Alabama's Smith Lake before summer's end, betting that years of friendship are enough to see them through.

results.name: Gordon
results.overview: Aníbal Gordon rises from a small-time thief to a convicted murderer in Argentina during the '70s.

results.name: Lo Chudail Chali Sasural
results.overview: Lo Chudail Chali Sasural is a supernatural family sitcom and the Indian adaptation of Bewitched. Urvashi, a chudail longing for a human family, marries Aarav Patel and joins his lively Gujarati joint family. As her magic causes hilarious mishaps, Aarav struggles to protect her secret while her human-hating mother Kamini fuels the chaos. Amid magical mayhem, and family drama, love finds a way.

results.name: Friz i Wersow. W drodze
results.overview: The production will follow Friz and Wersow as they embark on a new chapter in their lives—as parents of two children, business partners, and a couple ready to confront previously untold aspects of their own story. The six-part documentary series will premiere exclusively on Prime Video later this year.

results.name: Mr & Mrs Office
results.overview: Mr & Mrs Office explores the comedic and chaotic worlds of work-life balance, relationships, and corporate dynamics. The plot centers around a couple navigating the daily grind, combining relatable office tropes with domestic humor and romance.

results.name: Win the Mall
results.overview: Ten teams move into a mall where they must conquer storefronts, forge alliances and outsmart rivals to win $1 million in this reality competition series.

results.name: Pieces of Guilt
results.overview: Detective Qin Yuejian uses her extraordinary photographic memory to solve difficult cases, despite the burden of constantly reliving every detail. When newly transferred officer Liang Wan becomes her partner, the two work together to investigate bizarre crimes while confronting secrets from their pasts.

results.name: El doble
results.overview: "El doble" is a hybrid format that combines the documentary genre with musical entertainment across three episodes. Hosted by producer Jordi Cubino, the show aims to find, select, and train a contemporary performer capable of reviving the Eurodance music phenomenon of the 1980s. Through a casting and preparation process, the program recreates the success and cultural impact that Cubino himself experienced during that decade under the stage name David Lyme.

results.name: The Law of Beasts
results.overview: When the case of a child serial killer resurfaces after 25 years as an unresolved legal and social problem, two former friends are forced to confront the choices that broke their friendship and shaped their lives.

results.name: Small Town Trouble: Texas
results.overview: Set in Boerne, Texas, the series follows a charming yet unconventional group of mothers and social insiders and their husbands as conservative small-town values collide with forbidden attraction, messy friendships, and shocking secrets. Here, perception is everything, temptation is everywhere, and the truth is never as buttoned-up as it looks.

results.name: Her Willing Subject
results.overview: Reborn after a tragic end in their previous lives, Lu Qingcang and Shen Shuying resume their rivalry as regent and empress, but find themselves drawn together as they gradually uncover the truth.

results.name: Valentina and the 12 Signs
results.overview: After a devastating breakup, Valentina decides to date one man from every zodiac sign. But the universe has other plans.
